settings.faq_1_q: Which Kisah store is nearest to me?
settings.faq_1_a: We have 4 stores in Kolkata: Gariahat (opposite Spencer's), Lake Mall (3rd floor), Lindsay Street (Chowringhee Road) and Allenby Road (near Forum Mall). Tap 'Get directions' on any store card above to navigate directly.
settings.faq_2_a: All Kisah stores in Kolkata are open daily from 10:30 AM to 9:30 PM, all 7 days of the week.
settings.faq_3_a: No appointment is needed! Walk in anytime during store hours. Our in-store fashion stylists will assist you with personalized styling, draping, and sizing.
settings.faq_4_a: Yes. We offer expert alterations on sleeve length, chest, waist, and pant hem to ensure your garment fits you like it was custom-made.
settings.faq_5_q: Can I exchange an online order at the store?
settings.faq_5_a: Yes! We provide hassle-free exchanges within 7 days of delivery. Simply bring your unworn outfit with original tags and invoice to any of our retail boutiques.
settings.faq_6_q: Are store prices the same as online?
settings.faq_6_a: Yes, all prices and official promotions are completely identical online and in-store.
settings.faq_7_q: Do you have kids' and plus sizes?
settings.faq_7_a: Yes! We carry complete ranges from kids ethnic wear (toddler to teen) up to plus sizes (up to 5XL/6XL in select designs).
settings.faq_8_a: Yes. Lake Mall has dedicated mall parking. Gariahat, Lindsay Street and Allenby Road stores have convenient street and nearby parking lots.
